name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A row of slides that snap into place, with white round outline buttons for previous and next.
usage: Browse a set of comparable things one or a few at a time where scrolling sideways is natural: customer stories, template previews, screenshots of a feature. Show part of the next slide (basis-4/5) so people see there is more, and let touch and trackpads scroll it.
avoid: Hiding essential content in later slides
Arrows without a disabled state at the ends

reference.source: src/components/sections/shared/CustomerStoriesCarousel.tsx (the site carousel and its round arrows)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
